rows.TEXT: In his youth, this mighty lord once stood fast against an army from hell and single-handedly defeated them by sealing the gateway that spew them. He then became sovereign of his realm.

Highest lord of the dwarf lords, he is known for his intensity in battle and his courage in the face of overwhelming odds. He once fought seven days and nights against the mighty red dragon ARFURUZON to finally defeat him.

Every child trembles at the hearing of this most infamous name. This lord of hell is known for her blood thirsts. It is said that she once ate 1000 slaves at a banquet given by Bethrezen for a victory against the kingdom of light.

Known in his times as the mightiest of all adepts of the black art, this lord was slain by the inquisitor Vorgel who ended his reign of terror. He is now resurrected as an undead with the intention to subjugate every mortal to his will.

Counselor 
"Master! Crowley has requested our assistance once again. He wishes us to escort his troops to a specific meeting place. It is nearby, just south of our island."

Duke 
"Sniveling humans! Why does Crowley not come and meet us here himself? All this sneaking around. We are not cowards, like those puny humans. Tell them to meet us here, and now!"

Counselor 
"Careful now! We do not want to compromise the advantage Bethrezen has given us! They think we are servants of the Highfather, we must play the part. They led us to Lachla'an; they will lead us to the well. We will take no risks!"

Counselor 
"The instructions say that to find the meeting spot we must move to the south, and then east when the mountains come to an end. We will continue east until we come to the great falls in a small valley."

Scout 
"Master, the lands ahead are not owned by Crowley as we had anticipated. Perhaps they were driven away?"

Humans 
"We survived Crowley's Inquisition, we'll survive worse. Don't think you own this city. Every shadow you see will be one of us, silently waiting for your fall."

Counselor 
"What do you mean? Crowley simply abandoned this town? Why? Strange, and very unlike him. Oh, what a shame! More human flesh for us to play with!"

Humans 
"We survived Crowley's Inquisition, we'll survive worse. Don't think you own this city. Every shadow you see will be one of us, silently waiting for your fall."

Counselor 
"Silence! You are our prisoners now! You'll wish that cowardly Crowley still ruled you once your head is hung up in these halls!"

Knight 
"Perhaps you mistakenly believe that you have the upper hand here - well, believe me, you have won this battle, but there will be many more!"

Duke 
"We will see if you keep that rebellious tone while you endure an eternity of pain!"

Advisor 
"These Greenskins are always around, aren't they, Master? Like maggots squirming over rancid meat."

Duke 
"The riches looted from this city will surely help us in our task. And we do need all the help we can get, since that foolish Crowley failed. If I could only get my claws into him."

Counselor 
"The feebleminded Greenskins have nothing of significance to tell us. After all, they were mere pawns for the secretive Elves."

Dwarf King
"Leave! Word of your deeds has gone out to our cousins! Leave now and you might never have to meet them!"

Counselor 
"Our scouts report that the Clans live nearby, however they do not seem like much of a threat. There aren't any signs of Elves. We should just move on, this village doesn't seem worth our time. It is Elf flesh, not Dwarf flesh we crave!"

Counselor 
"We have searched far and wide for a sign of Elves; finally we have found it. The beasts guarding this castle are sign of things to come. The Elves will summon greater and more ferocious ones as we approach the triad."

Demon Lord 
"Yes. We are coming closer; Bethrezen's call becomes louder. We must move south, I feel he is counseling us"

Duke 
"The stench of Undead rot is nearly unbearable here - and this really isn't anywhere near the Elves. We don't need to be here, do we?"

Duke 
"I think we've gone the wrong way - I don't see any Elves, only rotten carcasses and dead trees..."

Goblins 
"Yes, we tell you! We seen the Elves! Do not hurt! They live far north! Monsters, have mercy! Mercy!"

Counselor 
"The Undead are gaining in power and spreading beyond the reach of their homeland. Why is Mortis freeing them from their servitude?"

Duke 
"This tower was key to producing soldiers for the Empire. We have done well by annihilating their forces!"

Advisor 
"I cannot imagine why the Empire continued to allow these "heretics" to practice here. They normally zealously protect their land from unbelievers."

Counselor 
"Greenskins burned down this shop, there is no doubt about it. I can't say we wouldn't have done the same!! Ha ha ha!"

Advisor 
"Interesting how the Clans can persist in remaining divided when clearly, strength lies in unity. Small, feeble minds for a small, feeble people. Bethrezen would never allow such rats into his kingdom."

Counselor 
"The Dwarves favor these guard towers, but they haven't done them any good, have they?"

Advisor 
"The red dragon is quite an awesome beast. It enjoys the lava almost as much we do, but the stench is too strong!"

Counselor 
"We've been tearing the limbs off these Humans for hours, but they won't tell us anything! However, we have found Elvish texts here. We cannot be far from their hiding place!"

Angel Guards 
"Heretics! These gates and the Highfather's Empire are protected! Back devils, back to where you belong!"

Angel Guards 
"You will get the same treatment next time, fiends!"

Elder One 
"We know who you seek. These are lands of the Dwarves, not the Elves. Turn Northwards, and leave us to live in peace."

Valkyrie 
"Enough! Back from whence you came!"

Counselor 
"Master, this is the area. Now where are Crowley and his troops?"

Knights of the Empire 
"Hark! The Empire has captured the traitors, and extracted your plans from them. They revealed to us this meeting - you are to be executed, by Emry of Abrissel's orders!"
Capture the Elven cities triad without the help of Crowley's Army.

Counselor 
"I see what has happened here, Master. The Empire must have toppled Crowley's forces. This leaves us significantly weaker than we had hoped."

Duke 
"Who needs the assistance of mortals? We are the spawn of mighty Bethrezen!"

Counselor 
"The Greenskins won't be needing these..."

Elf Lords 
"Drullia'an! No! It is the end for us now!"

Demon Lord 
"It is time! Come Bethrezen, come! Bring your blood gushing forth from the well! Burn all the lands! Bethrezen! Bethrezen!"

Duke 
"We are entering the Elven realm, master. I can sense it! There is a purity to the air that is unmistakable - it offends every part of me!"

Counselor 
"The Elves have built a number of strategically placed castles along the path to the well, in order to protect it. We should not be surprised if a number of defenders, even Impure ones, are summoned up by the greatest mages of the Elves."

Advisor 
"What? Elven trickery? They must know we are coming, Master! No doubt that they are trying to keep their location hidden from us. We should be on the lookout for a secret passage or anything of the like."

Lanar the Wise 
"You may continue on your path destruction, fiends, but it will not lead you where you expect."

Counselor 
"A road is a road, Elf, and it will lead us wherever we please!"

Snakeskin 
"What do you waaant, Firessskinsss? The Elvesss are Eassst of here. Leave usss, we do not have what you want!"

Duke 
"We will be seeing more and more exotic monsters in the area, Master, as we are approaching the domain of Elgrid, the great Elven tamer of monsters. They are drawn to him like a moth to fire."

Counselor 
"The odor here is practically unbearable, master. Why did we venture this far into their lair?"

Duke 
"We are approaching the borders of undead territory. The Humans have set a watch in case of attack, but they shouldn't pose much of a threat."

Counselor 
"This is no real city. No walls, no dungeons. It simply isn't fit for a Demon Lord. We cannot stay here."

Infernal Knight 
"We have them cornered! We must press on! For the glory of Bethrezen!"

Succubus 
"Bethrezen's cry shatters my ears! He demands that we release his power! Please Master, he is so angry! Bethrezen commands you! His fever is within me, he needs us to find the well! Release his plague!"

Doppleganger 
"I hear it too! Purify the land with fire!"

Abyssal Devil 
"Glory to the King of Hell! Burn it all!"

Counselor 
"Bethrezen's cry is reaching a fever pitch within us, Master, we must press on! We won't be able to control our troops for much longer!"

Drullia'an 
"At our doors you stand. No enemy has ever penetrated the hidden city of Zhilovers. We will not allow it. I would rather die defending it!"

Duke 
"You will, Elf Princess. You will!"

Succubus 
"Master, as we move into the heart of the Elven territory, we will no doubt face the purest form of their revolting magicks. We have no idea what the Elves will call upon to protect their forests..."

Succubus 
"It would benefit us to be cautious with any arcane objects or potions we collect during our conquest of the mortals. We will most certainly need them."
